tools.name: film.info
tools.description: Probe a media file in your workspace (MP4/MOV, Matroska/WebM, MXF, MPEG TS/PS, Ogg, WAV or a still image): container, video and audio streams, duration in ms, timecode and size. Reads only; offline, pure-Rust codecs. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: film.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the film engine's catalog, in order, on the media file or FilmCraft project (.fcproj) at `path` in your workspace, then write the project (.fcproj), the active sequence transcoded (.mp4, .mov, .wav or .gif by `format` or the extension of `out`, `start_ms` to `end_ms`, at most 5 minutes; `audio` false drops the sound), or the frame at `at_ms` as a .png at most `max_side` pixels long to `out` when given. Each command is {id, params}. Only reviewed commands run: those the skill's commands.md lists untagged (work inside the document), and `captions.import` of a caption file in your workspace; anything that reaches other files, code, the network, devices or the app is refused before any command runs. Paths are relative to your workspace, and `out` must be a new file. Read the film-engine skill first.
